snippet.title: FREE UPDATE | Quarantine Zone x Dead by Daylight | Available NOW
snippet.description:
Quarantine Zone is available now on Steam and PC Game Pass: https://www.quarantinezone.game/

Four new Survivors from the terrifying world of #deadbydaylight have arrived at the gates of Quarantine Zone! Inspect them for infection and direct them as you see fit now with this free update on PC.

Thanks to @BehaviourInteractive !

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/
